• International Automotive Company with office Brussels and Antwerp
• French Speaking environment
Client Details

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description
Your responsibilities
• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.
Your profile
• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Robert Half is currently looking for a Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist (m/f/x) for a permanent position.

 

Our client is an international company located in Groot-Bijgaarden.

 

As a Cost Accounting, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and ensuring accurate cost tracking.
• Processing and reviewing invoices while maintaining accurate accounting records.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations and journal entries.
• Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.
• Preparing financial reports and supporting internal and external audits.
• Contributing to process improvements and ensuring compliance with internal procedures.
 

The required qualifications for this position of Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent through experience.
• You have at least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Experience within the Services or Retail sector is required.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of French, German or other European languages is considered an asset.
• You have advanced Excel skills and experience working with SAP. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Experience in an international or shared service environment and knowledge of IFRS are considered strong assets.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for a Purchase Order Manager. You will report to the Finance Manager.

This is not a procurement role. Instead, it is a finance-focused position where accounting knowledge, financial controls and process governance are essential.

• 
Lead, coach and develop a team of Finance Operations professionals.

• 
Ensure the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders.

• 
Maintain the quality and integrity of vendor master data while ensuring compliance with financial controls.

• 
Partner closely with Accounting to support accurate financial reporting, month-end close and reconciliation activities.

• 
Collaborate with Finance and cross-functional teams to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality operations.

• 
Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and business integration projects.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of Purchase-to-Pay processes, financial controls and operational efficiency.

• 
Act as the key contact for Finance Operations, providing expert support to internal stakeholders.

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s in accounting, finance, economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
Several years experience in accounting/controlling.

• 
3+ years in financial management/leadership; experience with system-driven procurement processes.

• 
SAP MM/FI, S/4HANA, advanced Excel, and strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for an Accounting Specialist. You will join an international environment where Finance, Operations, HR, Tax, and Real Estate work closely together. This role exists to ensure that accounting and reporting processes across multiple markets are carried out accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who is analytically strong, communicates fluently, and feels comfortable in a dynamic and collaborative culture.

Your responsibilities

• 
Coordinate the administration of invoices and obligations related to leasing, housekeeping, payroll, property taxes, and travel expenses.

• 
Monitor budgets and analyze deviations in recurring costs and monthly closings.

• 
Oversee reconciliations, intercompany positions, and payroll reconciliations.

• 
Prepare VAT, property tax, and other tax filings in collaboration with the Tax department.

• 
Support external audits, year-end closing, and the preparation of statutory financial statements.

• 
Assist in the integration of new or acquired stores into accounting processes.

• 
Contribute to ESG data collection, budget preparation, and process improvements.

• 
Support and coach team members and new colleagues where necessary.

Your profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in accounting.

• 
Experience with financial statements, IFRS, and local GAAP.

• 
Experience in services or retail is required.

• 
Experience with SAP; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with ERP/CRM migrations and UAT is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English and French; German is a strong plus.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office.

• 
Accurate, independent, communicative, and solution-oriented.

For a growing organisation in the services sector we are looking for a Finance Operations Specialist. 

You will work closely with local accounting teams and other internal stakeholders across Europe.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Monitor expenses and commitments for real estate projects across Europe

• 
Support the preparation and review of local GAAP accounting memos

• 
Manage the daily administration of invoices and purchase orders

• 
Review and analyze invoice postings, including VAT and entity details

• 
Analyze new real estate projects such as construction, renovation, and maintenance

• 
Support communication with external parties such as contractors, suppliers, and government authorities

• 
Assist with the financial reporting of investment projects (actuals, budget, and forecast)

• 
Follow up on payment schedules together with local accounting teams

• 
Support month-end and quarter-end closings within real estate accounting

• 
Assist with depreciation, capitalization, and reconciliations

• 
Support internal and external audits

• 
Contribute to ESG reporting

• 
Assist in implementing procedures and control systems in line with internal standards

• 
Support the rollout of control processes across different markets

• 
Support process improvements and special accounting projects

Your Profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience

• 
1–3 years of experience in accounting

• 
Experience in a real estate environment is a plus

• 
Fluent in English

• 
Experience in an international or shared services environment is a plus

• 
Knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP is an asset

• 
Proficient in Microsoft Office, with advanced Excel skills

• 
Experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus

Robert Half is currently looking for a Senior Corporate Accountant (m/f/x) for a permanent position.

 

Our client is an international company located in Groot-Bijgaarden.

 

As a Senior Corporate Accountant, your responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating accounting activities and ensuring accurate financial reporting.
• Supervising month-end and year-end closing activities, reconciliations and general ledger processes.
• Monitoring budgets, costs and financial performance within the assigned scope.
• Managing tax compliance, audit support and statutory reporting requirements.
• Supporting business projects, process improvements and the integration of new entities.
• Coaching accounting team members and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
 

 

The required qualifications for this position of Senior Corporate Accountant are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent through experience.
• You have at least 5 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• You have experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within an international or shared service environment is considered an asset.
• A first people management or coaching experience is a plus.
• Experience within the Services or Retail sector is required.
• You have knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with ERP implementations, migrations or system improvement projects is a strong asset.
• You are fluent in English and French.
• You have advanced Excel skills and experience working with SAP. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

As a Production Technician, you will provide technical support within an automated production environment, with a 50/50 split between mechanical and electrical work. You will troubleshoot, analyse and resolve technical faults on a varied range of machinery, including CNC machines, robots, milling and sawing machines, while also carrying out preventive maintenance and implementing improvements together with the Technical Manager. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, as well as thorough training and ongoing support in a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

 
• 
You have experience as a Operator.

 
• 
You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
You can speak English. This is a requirement for the position.

 
• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills
